candidate.data_title: Riverscape snorkeling surveys of salmonid distribution and abundance before (2007, 2008) and after (2018, 2019) dam removal on the Elwha River, Washington
blockers: ScienceBase catalog file manifest unavailable via web; DOI resolves to item ID, not file-level checksums or bytes.
Survey unit changed from reach (2007) to channel unit later; common reach aggregation and effort denominator need inspection; former reservoirs, canyons and additional sections unsurveyed.
Hatchery operations and intentional adult relocations explicitly described; upstream source changes cannot be silently modeled as natural dispersal.
Dates of physical removal are not calibrated passability dates; rockfall and sediment/flow uncertainties must be encoded independently of fish outcomes.
Mainstem graph/hydrography and alternative source registry not frozen; no field transition calibration yet.
Published aggregate outcome and some first-sighting text exposed during literature methods retrieval; no raw heldout rows, no claim of fully blinded external validation.
